SongNodes: System Architecture, Storage Hubs & Data Flow
{SVG_COMMON_DEFS}
System Architecture: End-to-End Data Flow, Storage Hubs & Service Contracts Authoritative topology map covering Scrapers, PostgreSQL Medallion Core, Memgraph Graph, Redis Broker, and Sister Project (musicLibrary)
External Web & Broadcast Sources
1001Tracklists & MixesDB Spiders Playwright Chromium & MediaWiki API · Complete sets
Community Radio (PBS, 3RRR, TripleJ) Airnet REST & HTML scraping · Weekly Sunday harvest
Metadata Waterfall Providers TIDAL v2, Deezer, MusicBrainz ref_mb, Discogs, Last.fm
Unified Scraper Service (:8012) POST /scrape · Scrapy + Playwright headless engine
Contract: RawScrapePayload Guards: No gaps in track sequence 1..N
Storage Hub: PostgreSQL 16 Medallion Store (pgdata)
Bronze Layer (Raw Immutable Storage) Unprocessed external tracklist captures preserving source positions
TABLE: bronze_scraped_playlists TABLE: bronze_scraped_tracks (1..N) Rule: Incomplete playlists marked failed immediately
Celery Ingestion & Enrichment Worker Drains ingestion_jobs · Idempotent by key · Distributed lease
Jobs: ingest_pending (60s) · er_shadow Jobs: enrichment_backfill · camelot_repair
Silver Layer (Cleaned & Enriched Truth) Canonical entities, multi-provider evidence & observed transitions
TABLE: silver_enriched_tracks TABLE: silver_enriched_artists TABLE: silver_track_transitions (pos N -> N+1) TABLE: silver_track_metadata_evidence TABLE: silver_sets & entity_redirects Guards: Valid artist on both ends; no placeholder IDs
Gold Projection Layer (Denormalized Cache) Fast query views refreshed by projection_consume worker
TABLE: projection_tracks (rebuildable) VIEW: v_ready_transitions
Library Overlay Schema (library.*) User crate curation, rotation status, saved setlists & tags
TABLES: library.crates, library.saved_sets TABLES: library.appearances, library.track_tags
Operational Memory & Graph Topology
Memgraph Graph Database (:7687 Bolt) In-memory Cypher engine for transition traversals
Node: (:Track {id, bpm, camelot, energy}) Edge: [:TRANSITIONS_TO {occurrences, w}] Query: shortestPath((a)-[*]-(b)) Sub-50ms wave-shaped harmonic routing Sync: Batched from Silver Transitions
Redis 7.2 Broker & Cache (:6379) Task queuing, rate limits, lock leases & telemetry
Celery Broker Queue: celery Worker Leases: job_leases:* (TTL) Scraper Window Telemetry: scraper_window:* Rate Limits: rate_limit:tidal:* FastAPI Cached Queries: cache:library:* Guards: Atomic lock acquisition; auto-expiry
Application Services: FastAPI REST API (:8082)
Modular Router Registry (G3 Pattern) Discovered by router_registry · Self-registering endpoints
library_search & catalog_reads GET /api/v1/library/search | /tracks
tidal_playlists & spotify_playlists POST /api/v1/tidal/sets/send
pathfinder & datalayer POST /api/v1/pathfinder/find-path
target_tracks & catalog_writes POST /api/v1/tracks/import-tracklist
jobs & scrape_window GET /api/v1/jobs | /scrape/window
music_auth & api_keys (SEC6) OAuth token exchange · Encrypted keys
Internal Engine & Worker Services Specialised backend capabilities running in container network
Metadata Enrichment Service (:8081) Waterfall logic with strict consensus scoring Evidence: snapshotted per provider Rule: Unknown stays unknown (no BPM 0)
Graph Projection Service Silver-to-Gold and Silver-to-Memgraph projection Polls outbox events every 15 seconds Computes transition weights & cuts
Reference Data & Entity Resolver Consolidated under services/reference_data/ ref_mb: SQLite mirror of MusicBrainz ISRC matching · Reversible merges Legacy ID redirection preservation
Client Interfaces & musicLibrary
SongNodes React App (Vite + TS) Single Design System source of truth · AppShell
/library · LibraryPage.tsx Crate filter · Audio preview · Set Target
/sets · SetBuilderPage.tsx Wave curve · Camelot compat · Send to TIDAL
/paths · PathfinderPage.tsx Harmonic stepping stones · Graph query
/sources/targets & /sources/import Target tracks queue · AI OCR parser
/pipeline · ScraperProgressPage.tsx Scraper telemetry · Dead-letter retry
/settings · SettingsPage.tsx OAuth callbacks · Encrypted API tokens
Browser Storage & Exports localStorage: songnodes_saved_sets localStorage: songnodes_theme Exports: CSV (OWASP guard) | M3U | Print
Sister Project: musicLibrary e:\musicLibrary · Melbourne Club DJ Pipeline
pipeline/run_weekly.py Sunday 7:37am scheduled pipeline run scrape -> resolve -> process -> db
db/dj_library.sqlite Tracks, appearances, crates, rotation Outputs: library.json, crates/*.csv
Rekordbox XML & TIDAL Sync outputs/rekordbox_musicLibrary.xml TIDAL Playlists: 01_HighRot_*, SET · *
Naarm Set Builder (Artifact) artifact/index.html · Standalone selector Bridge: sync-music-library.sh Design System aligned v1.4.0
